origine_fr: Le chien 犭 et 昔, lu xī, qui ne donne pas le son liè ; autrefois, 巤 donnait le son. Le chien court après le gibier. C'est la chasse, 打猎.
origine_en: A dog 犭 and 昔, read xī, which does not give the sound liè; 巤 used to give it. The dog runs after game. That is hunting, 打猎.

phrase.zh: 他爷爷年轻时经常上山打猎。
phrase.pinyin: Tā yéye niánqīng shí jīngcháng shàng shān dǎliè.
phrase.fr: Dans sa jeunesse, son grand-père allait souvent chasser dans la montagne.
phrase.en: When he was young, his grandfather often went hunting in the mountains.
